items.description: The agreement will allow young people between 18 and 31 year-olds to travel, work or study in the EU for up to three years.

items.title: Mouldy, infested housing for vulnerable people sold as ethical investments abroad
items.description: The properties are marketed at premium prices with claims of “government-backed” returns, the BBC finds.
